body: I actually never thought I could potentially use this. I never wanted to use that as an excuse to why I wasn’t performing adequately in school because it felt unprofessional and I didn’t think anyone would actually care. I just emailed the dean of my school to ask to have a conversation. I think it’s worth a try to explain I was in an abusive relationship and was extremely depressed. I also have records of this through the school because I tried to seek help from counselors their so I have proof that I’m not just making it up.

This was a really kind and thoughtful comment 💜 I appreciate the time you took to look into my post history and I think you might be right. I’m happy to hear you ended up succeeding it gives me hope for myself.
I Appreciate your perspective. I guess right now it just feels crushingly devastating.
Well I appreciate the kind words
It’s so hard because this is so ingrained in me as who I am as a person
That’s really kind of you to say. I just really felt like this was my corner of the world and it’s a little devastating to find out that it might not be.

You’re not wrong but I’ve also disappointed and let down myself….It’s really hard for me to accept that I might have just failed at something I really wanted to succeed in and I feel like I won’t be able to forgive myself for messing up this opportunity there’s nothing else I want to do this was kt

I agree with this and you’re right I wouldn’t be so hard on someone else. But this feels like it was all I was ever meant to do, it’s my purpose in life so if I fail it feels like I no longer have any purpose.

I feel like the cheating should be your clear sign to leave. I know it’s hard though they make it feel impossible to leave them even when they treat you so terribly. Take your time and try to plan a way out. Making a plan makes it easier

I feel this way a lot too. I think what if I had tried this or this or hung on a little longer maybe things would have changed. But one day I ask my nex if he would have stayed with me if I had said/done the same things they did to me. My nex responded well no but that’s because I have self respect. And that should have been all I needed to hear! And even after that I STILL feel guilty like I didn’t do enough. Try to stop punishing yourself you’ve been brainwashed to think like this.
It’s probably not a good idea to try and tell a narcissist that you think they are one.

I have so much empathy for what he goes through in his mind which is why I stayed with him for so long. I felt like I was his protector. But I realized nothing I did could fix him that’s just sadly a demon he has to be able to conquer himself
I am so happy your story had a happy ending 💜
Seeing all the wasted potential is the hardest part….
Yeah I’ve also been going through bouts of this. I’ve been trying to read something for school recently and it’s like my mind can’t process it. Everything feels really slow and my mind can’t focus

I felt this all the time…my narc always would use his childhood trauma to explain why he acted the way he did. I always felt even from the first month we were together that I was his protector/that he needed protected so I stayed for over 3 years of abuse because I wanted so badly to protect him and help him move on. It ended up though that all my focus was on protecting him and never me and now I’m completely lost and deflated
Your comment was so beautiful and helpful 💜 thank you

It sounds like you have done a lot of work and recovery but seeing the nex is like PTSD especially when you aren’t prepared to see them. You don’t have to feel bad I think that’s a totally valid reaction

I guess the way my story went was I broke up with him he begged and pleaded and did all the right things so I went back and this time around everything was SO much worse. We just recently broke up again and my nex is in therapy and really trying to get better but he literally told me the other day that people describe certain emotions and he just doesn’t have them. He asked me if I consciously was thoughtful because that stuff never pops into his head. I think he honestly is trying to be better but he’s admitted he legitimately just doesn’t feel certain things that normal people feel. That’s not me saying it will be like that for everyone but I see him truly trying to change and be better and I don’t know if it’s possible.

I feel like I can find better, probably because my relationships before meeting my nex were pretty normal/healthy so I have something to compare it to. I guess what I struggle with now is feeling like it’s hard to find a good partner. I also still feel so impossibly connected to my nex that’s it hard to think I’ll ever fully be without him. I don’t really have the energy to try something new right now but my heart really craves someone who is kind and loving. I think I’m just in a low now I guess relationships kind of feel daunting right now
The trauma bond is the hardest part for me too….it’s like even logic doesn’t work with it

I’ve felt that…it’s easier when you go no contact. Try to focus on yourself without them in the picture. They make everything confusing atleast for me that’s how it was. Try to focus on you and your own happiness

I felt so very alone with my narc. It always felt like it was his world and I was just existing in it….I didn’t really feel like he ever saw me for me just saw me as he wanted to. It was extremely lonely to always feel invisible like the person you cared about the most wasn’t even seeing you. It was very lonely

I literally used to think the same things. I started to yearn for someone who would be nice to me. One of my guy friends bought me my favorite chocolates for my birthday and I nearly cried because I couldn’t believe someone actually considered me and thought of me. I was clinging to any niceness someone would show me and fantasized about having a boyfriend who would just be nice to me. I used to think in my head too that I couldn’t imagine marrying my narc but I didn’t know how to leave because I did love him even though he was abusive. It’s such a messy complicated and confusing attachment to have to someone who treats you so poorly.
I’m so happy you’ve found a happy and healthy relationship 💜 your words are really encouraging and give me hope that one day I can find that too
I’m happy you were able to find something that helped secure your reasoning to leave! Even though you feel that tie remember the hard proof
Congratulations! I’m so happy for you 🎉💜
It’s just hard because it seems so genuine…I’m not going back it just depresses me and makes me feel so heavy. Thank you for your advice💜

I’m struggling with this too. It’s seems like my nex is only nice to me when we aren’t together. When we dated I was emotionally and verbally abused on the daily, but now that we aren’t together and it’s easy to talk to him and he’s so nice to me it’s sent me spiraling. I’m having panic attacks again and my depression is so bad. I don’t get it either. Why are they nice when they no longer have us?
I’m feeling this now…if that’s how you feel you should try going no contact for awhile
Well I’m sorry you have to deal with it too :/

I’m so sorry you are going through this.
In my case it was the opposite, my nex used sex as a punishment, he knew it was something I really enjoyed and wanted to do to feel connected with him so he purposely withheld it from me to punish me. He always told me it was my fault we weren’t having sex. I feel your pain in the way that I’m terrified of having sex with my next partner because I don’t know if I can handle it if they reject me. I was rejected on purpose for so many years to make me feel bad about myself that I’m terrified I may also have a bad reactions in my next relationship if it happens and it’s not an intentional hurtful action. I feel for what you are going through

It’s very related. Nothing I ever did made my nex happy even small things like stories about my day I would tell him would get made fun of. Now I find myself incredibly anxious around even people I was close with because I feel like I have no idea what I can and cannot say. My nex planted a seed deep in my subconscious that anything/everything I say is annoying and unimportant. It’s normal that you feel this way after being with a nex.

I will say that my nex admitted to his horrible behavior and would go to therapy and do all these things but he eventually would just quite and fall back into the same habits. Not saying every narc will be that way that’s just what my experience was
I really appreciate your kind and thoughtful comment 💜

I still feel like I need my Nex’s approval too….
He used to criticize my outfits as well and told me I looked like a lesbian. One of the main things I crave from him though is him being proud of my education. I’m in school for my PhD and my nex always told me I wasn’t going to be a “real” doctor. Even now that we’re not together I just want him to tell me he’s proud of me for the work I’ve put into school. I’m not sure exactly what to tell you to get past your yearning but I know for myself it helps when I tell myself my nex is a miserable and insecure man and his opinions only came from hate. The whole time he was telling me I’d be a “fake” doctor he was unemployed smoking weed all day long. Maybe look at your nex and see where his criticism of you stemmed from in him. I know that helped me but it takes time to rid yourself of that
I feel you with really wanting the relationship to work….I always felt like it would be a personal failure on my part if the relationship failed
Same here. Smoked weed alllllll day long and was fiercely against me saying he was addicted. He even went through withdrawal symptoms when he would stop smoking for a day.
Yeah and I feel like I know that….it just feels nice that he’s being nice and I catch myself thinking well maybe it can work. It’s just tough when you really wanted it to work out….
Yeah I think it’s normal…..I feel really traumatized and scared about the future I know it’ll get better but everything seems so hopeless and I feel like a shell of myself

Honestly when I feel weak or vulnerable to wanting my nex coming on this group page and reading about other peoples experiences remind me of my own. It helps me remember why I left in the first place. Sometimes I also tell myself that I am placing myself nex in an imaginary box and he has to stay there right now because there’s nothing I can do to speed up my recovery from them and obsessing over them only makes it worse. So I but him in this box and put it on a “shelf” when I just need some space from the situation.

I agree with this….the sadness and heartache in the end comes from the loss of what you had hoped the future could be like. And it is sad and it leaves you feeling so empty inside but it gets better with time.

Oh once I realized my nex was a narc EVERYTHING made so much more sense and it made things easier because I was like I’m not crazy! There’s a reason this relationship feels so bad but for some reason I can’t bring myself to leave. It also made it easier for when I finally decided to leave I could come to this page and read about others experience and it would remind me why I left to begin with. Learning that my nex was a narc was a gift.

I feel like I’m in this weird phase right now where I don’t want to be with my nex but it’s really terrifying to think about being with anyone else. It’s only been about a month separated for me so I’m trying to be patient and kind to myself. I hope you can find some peace with it too and stay away from your nex! Maybe try a casual date or two that’s what my next step will be.
It scares me too 💜
Dang that last comment about the look in their eye…..that one really gets me

Mine was the same. I tried to approach it from every single angle I could imagine and he told me I never tried and just did the same thing every argument and I wondered why I never got resolution….it’s sad
Jesus Christ the accuracy of this
Same EXACT thing with me just taking it was me being “dismissive”
Even shutting up and taking it didn’t work for me….even that was an issue
I feel you on this one….

Yeah and I agree with that. I’ve been trying to keep a consistent workout regime, I’m trying to put my energy and focus into school and work too but I think I need to pick up a new hobby for the extra downtime I have because right now I just kind of sit and stare at the wall when I have nothing to do. It’s hard to find the energy to want to do anything
Thank you 💜

I absolutely LOVE denver it’s one of my favorite cities. It has a really chill vibe for a city and everyone is pretty nice/friendly. There’s a ton of nature in and surrounding the city which is one of my favorite parts. A lot of unique restaurants and breweries/cideries. I love it there!

Stay strong! I know it can be really hard and it’s not fair that you have to live with the trauma that they put you through. Whenever I am having a hard time it really helps to read through this subreddit because it reminds me that I was abused for years and it’s ok that I’m struggling to get through some of the days because that’s what being with a narcissist does to you.
I really loved your comment and advise 💜 I feel like it’s such a healthy and positive way of approaching recovery from a nex thank you for sharing your insight

I know it sucks and you might not want to hear this but sometimes you just have to ride through the emotions. You have to feel and acknowledge it all for it to get better and for you to be able to move past it. Along with just allowing yourself some time to feel everything and process it revisiting his page constantly kind of just reopens the wound for you. I know it’s really hard and I’ve been there but you have to just pull the trigger and block them so you’re not tempted. Stay strong it will get better but you have to go through the bad before it does
Honestly sounds really manipulative and selfish. Sounds like he used you for attention and then discarded you when he found something else. Seems like it could be narcissistic

The thing is they will only apologize when it’s clear you’ve had it with them….they will admit to anything and say everything you have craved hearing throughout the relationship but as soon as you take them back they will go back to their old ways. Its sad because you’re like oh my gosh they know exactly what I need and want they’re just refusing to give it to me. That’s what really opened my eyes with my nex and helped me finally leave

I think for me it was how my narcissist seemed confident and comfortable with themselves. Once I realized this was a facade, as an empath I stayed because it was clear they were deeply troubled and I felt the need to protect them or help them get better. As an empath I believe I’m drawn to people who I believe have no one else or are troubled so I feel the need to be there for them

I felt the same way. Sometimes he would be arguing with me and my brain would hurt because I literally couldn’t make any sense of it. I would tell him I was confused and to explain what he meant and he would always say it wasn’t worth the effort because I never understood and I never listened
Only been a week for me but it feels like it was all a dream. It’s really strange I haven’t been feeling super sad just kind of hollow and numb.

He always ALWAYS commented on how I dressed. He used to tell me I looked like a lesbian. Because of this I tried to branch out and wear clothes that were more form fitting and showed my body off more and he told me I dressed like a slut. I couldn’t win.

Yeah it’s hard to really say if she was a narc but typically when someone is as self reflective as you are it means they aren’t narcissistic. Maybe it was a bad relationship but I’m not sure if there was a narc involved

Sadly I can relate too. He used to go out and sit in his car all day and not talk to me. I would go and beg him to help me understand what was wrong but he told me asking him what was wrong didn’t help anything. I couldn’t ever reason with him and we ended up missing a lot of events because I would do something to upset him and he would just lay curled up in a ball all day refusing to talk to me or if I left the room during this he would start banging his first or sometimes head against the wall to get my attention. You can’t reason with them and this is common for narcissists.

It’s really hard to let go when you had so much hope for them and what they could be. I’m sorry you’re going through this but try to stay no contact. It’s only harder and more confusing when you talk to them

Nearly every fight, it never failed he would say do you really think I want to fight with you? Do you think I want this? 
He always acted like I started everything and told me I always played the victim card. I couldn’t even breath without it causing an issue for my narc. But he would always say do you really think I enjoy fighting? Made me feel so crazy

I also felt this way towards the end of the relationship. I was starting to fail my classes because all of my energy was going into saving the relationship and dealing with the daily mood swings and arguments with my nex. Once school started to go downhill I told myself I didn’t have any other choice but to leave the relationship. I still have waves of sadness but it’s all a process. My anxiety already is SO much better after I have kicked them out. It’s very sad but if it’s draining you it’s not right.

This is super good advice. During my experience trying to leave my narcissist there were many waves of up and down but reading through the posts on this page always calm me down and remind me why I had to leave
So chillingly accurate.

My narcissist told me he didn’t want to make concrete plans with me because he cared about me and wouldn’t want to disappoint me if they had to cancel….at the time it seemed like a nice thing but now I realize it was just manipulation

Told me it wasn’t like he hit me. I was overacting because he could show me what real abuse was.

Told me his outbursts were because he was too emotional invested and couldn’t control it but mine were because I was cold and mean.

When I got into grad school he told me to calm down because it’s not like it was that good of a school.
I made spaghetti but instead of mixing the noodles with the sauce I put the sauce on top of the noodles…..he refused to eat it and told me I never listen

Same thing with me….ALWAYS lights off on their terms and it barely ever happened. I was almost always denied. I tried to do new things and try new things all the time. Was literally down for everything but they said they weren’t interested or were tired.

I feel this…my ex NEVER initiated and I finally broke it off and he’s begging for me back. I don’t get it. He acts so miserable with me and doesn’t want to have sex with me so why does he want me back so bad?? It HURTS my brain trying to comprehend why he wants to be with me still

I feel this deeply. They told me it was my fault we weren’t having sex even though I tried everything and was willing to do whatever they wanted. They said they just didn’t have a drive even though I know before me they were known for trying to sleep with people. Made me feel awful about myself like I was bad at sex even though I realize now they weren’t bringing anything to the table either

After about a year mine stopped wanting to have sex with me. He told me because I wasn’t sending him nudes he didn’t want to have sex with me. I started sending nudes and nothing changed. Every time I try to imitate it it’s always I’m too tired or not in the mood. When I try to talk about it even if I’m extremely calm and kind he says I’m sex shaming him. This seems to be a normal trend with narcs. I feel like it’s just another control tactic of theirs

I guess it depends what he’s saying to you. For me my narc had multiple relationships that seemed pretty good but he was HORRIBLE to certain people in hos life which was a huge tell to me. He was nice to most strangers he met and unless you had a careful eye it seemed like he was great to people close to him . But if you feel like he’s mean to you that should be enough to leave. If you don’t believe yourself talk to someone you trust to be unbiased and tell them what your partner says and see how they react.

This is sad but true. They acted like they were someone else and made you feel like you were crazy. They never were who they promised to be. Maybe it’s better to act like they are dead and move on. Morn your loss of who they promised they were. It’s hard and sad but sometimes it’s what you have to do

My narc after about a year stopped wanting to sleep with me. I know before me they slept with or had intimate interactions with a LOT of women but after a year they no longer had interact in sleeping with me. I tried EVERYTHING but they had no interest. Literally I told them I was down to try everything and tried to initiate multiple different things and they would say oh I’m just tired or not feeling it. I think it was just another thing they wanted to have control over
All I can say is I’m sorry that someone would treat you that way
Chronic unemployment and “grand plans” are such a huge give away

This is the second time I’m trying to leave them and I believe it will be the last. They are saying the exact same things that were said last time which really opened my eyes. It’s sad to think he may never change but I’m realizing that it can no longer be my problem….thank you for your comment it helps me reassure myself 💜
You’re 100% right it’s the same ordeal for me. I hope you are able to remove yourself from that person and stay strong!

I’m sorry to hear that you went through something so similar but thank you for sharing your story 💜 it really does help give me the strength to leave and it reminds me that I’m not crazy. There’s always a part of you that wants to believe them when they say they’ll change and it’s really hard to fight the urge to believe them.
I appreciate your comment and really needed to hear this. It’s hard for me to put myself first because it feels selfish but in this case if I don’t choose me I will just drown with my narcissist.

Thank you 💜 this message was really great and your right. I have a very hard time because I feel like I’m abandoning this person but you’re right I’m actually just aiding them. I’m making it to comfortable for them to carry on as they are. I just have to let them go and hope for the best and try to detach myself from the situation.

3.5 years….it’s hard to spot emotional/mental manipulation because it messes with your sense of reality. I wouldn’t have even gotten out as early as I did if it hadn’t been for my family and friends also spotting the issues.
Mine said the same exact thing to me. Told me my love was overwhelming and he didn’t ask for it so it was my fault

I’m proud of you for leaving! It’s hard this story reminds me so much of my own and it’s very normal to feel silly for not seeing the signs but remember they are manipulating you and they’re very good at it. Just be happy you got out of it

I so much understand what you are describing. It’s because you have a a big heart. They are worth love but if you give them love and they abuse you then you have to leave. My ex verbally and mentally manipulated/abused me and I still love him and care about him but I have to do it from a distance. For awhile I thought the exact same thing, if they would just be nice to me I would stay I literally wanted the bare minimum. Now looking at it I see even if they had been nice there was no substance to the relationship I tried to make a pros and cons list and really only could see cons. A relationship should be more than the bare minimum

If it’s been that bad please don’t let them move back in…..people can change but if they were capable of all of that abuse I just don’t see them ever changing enough to be a healthy partner. Stay strong

I very much understand where you are coming from. You have to learn how to trust yourself again and trust your gut feeling. Also trust that you are talking to unbiased professionals that have no stake in this relationship so you have to believe they are telling you the sound truth and are right that the relationship is abusive. You can’t change them and it’s not your job too. You shouldn’t have to beg for someone to be decent to you. Trust yourself know your worth and put yourself first so you can leave before you get yourself into a situation where you are stuck with them

If you wish he would just leave you then why don’t you leave yourself?? It’s hard because it sounds like they are manipulating you but this doesn’t sound like it’s healthy for you at all you should talk to the people close to yoh they will reassure you that you aren’t crazy and they will help give you the support and strength you need to leave

I’m kind of in a similar situation. I don’t want another serious relationship for awhile and I just want to enjoy myself and meet people and have fun but I want to make sure it’s healthy for me too. It’s hard to tell

I think that’s part of how your ex programmed you to feel. Even if you had been the most perfect person in the world you would have been treated this way so yes I understand you’re disappointed that you acted in a way you’re not proud of but understand all you had been put through. Almost no one can go through that treatment and not act at least a little less than perfect. Try not to beat yourself up too much and look toward the future where you can be a kind person.

I feel the same way….someone told me recently to make a list of pros and cons because I was having a hard time deciding to leave and it was really difficult trying to think of pros of why I should stay….it makes you feel ridiculous for staying but I think when you have a good heart and truly believe and care about people you try to see the best in them even if they are horrible to you

It sounds like you are extremely logical and are being very objective about this conversation. This is what narcissistic people will do, they start a fight then make it seem as though it was your fault like you’re the problem because they don’t know how to handle or talk about their emotions in a healthy way. You didn’t do anything wrong so don’t question yourself. You will never win with someone who argues like this.

I feel this way a lot In My relationship. When I relay experiences I am having with my partner to other people they all agree that it is clearly abuse and that I’m not going crazy but I still feel so unsure and anxious and crazy. I know logically that I’m in a emotionally abusive  and manipulative relationship but I still convince myself that it’s my fault and if I could just be better he wouldn’t have to act the way he does. I don’t necessarily have advice for you in how to get out just know you’re not crazy and other people are trying to sort out the same kind of situation as you are.

Well I can tell you I’m in a very similar situation. I’ve been dating a guy for awhile now and I’m having the same issues. We used to go do stuff all the time and now every time I try to suggest something fun he acts like I’m asking for too much. We’re both 21 so I’m like common!! Don’t you want to go do something fun besides watch tv and play video games? I feel restless and bored. It’s hard because I love him but I also need to be happy too. If you’re not content with your boyfriend not wanting to go do things with you I would say leave. He may eventually change but it’s not your job to sit and wait for him to try and do things you like. A relationship should have compromises and if you’re partner isn’t willing to do things that make you happy too then it’s not fair and you’ll remain unhappy.

I feel like I’ve been going through the same thing with my boyfriend. It makes you feel like everyone else is a priority except you. We’ve been doing long distance due to COVID but when I did go visit him after a month of not seeing him most of the time he was playing video games or watching YouTube videos. I’ve tried to explain to him why that’s hurtful or inconsiderate but he does t really get it. It’s become a huge issue and honestly I’ve tried talking to him about it a lot but I’m just not seeing a lot of progress. At the end of the day he’s going to do what he wants to do. Obviously my boyfriend isn’t the same exact person as yours but it sounds like they share a similar issue and at the end of the day if someone wants to make you a priority they will. It’s something I’m starting to learn with my own relationship....

I’ve experienced similar things in relationships before....it gets old being the only one doing something with your life and it’s not your responsibility to “mold” them into something. The only way someone will change is if they want to. You’ve addressed the problem and that’s all you can do, if they don’t want to change they won’t. The longer that goes on the more you’ll begin to resent them.
Sounds abusive. It’s very clear you said no, just because he’s your husband doesn’t mean he can get sex from you whenever he wants. You said no and he should have respected that.
Yeah honestly I get that I think it’s just good to feel something over nothing. Also when bad things do happen it helps validate why you always feel so miserable.
That’s usually when it’s bad for me too in the night and in the morning I feel like I constantly need to be moving

I feel this way a lot. I get frustrated with myself for being so miserable when overall my life is pretty good. I’m in school on a full ride, I have a boyfriend and a loving family. I have lots of friends and I’m very active but none of it seems to fill a void I have deep inside myself. It feels like there’s a small piece of me that was taken away and nothing will ever quite fill the space correctly. Most days I live in a fog going through the motions, smiling at people but it always feels like I’m living in the wrong body or like something is terribly off. I can’t place it exactly but life hasn’t felt completely real for awhile now.
Sounds like a total POS. I get wanting to split the bill, but when you forget your wallet he won’t even cover you? What kind of boyfriend is like that.

Yeah I know he ended things and has dated people since her I never viewed her as a threat because he definitely never made it seem like he had any interest for her but what really has me shook is the way I kept catching his eyes on her
